Scholarship overview

This RMIT scholarship supports biomedical research linked to an NHMRC Ideas grant. The project investigates respiratory infection and possible therapeutic approaches, offering a defined research topic rather than a general scholarship across all biomedical subjects.

Research Areas

  • Respiratory infection
  • Biomedical science
  • Therapeutics

Funding and duration

ComponentDetails
Award or positionPhD scholarship / studentship
Stipend / salaryAUD 33,826/year
DurationUp to three years, subject to award conditions

This is a defined respiratory infection research project, not a general funding award across the School.
